turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello, and I am sorry the print does not suit your wall. To check a return, I need your order number (SC- and four digits) and the email the order was placed with.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Ysolde. Your return for order SC-5211 (Păunul de ceață, 40x50 cm) is filed as request R-1. Staff must approve it before anything changes. Under the shop rule, catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must also approve any refund. The order was delivered on 12 November 2026, so it is within that window.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.

Thank you. The return for order SC-5211 is already filed as request R-1, so I have not filed it again. Staff must approve it. You noted that you will pay the return postage, and that you do not want a reprint. I have not changed anything else on the order.
